name: google-business-profile-performance-report
description: Shows how a Google Business Profile listing is doing, from live Google Business Profile data in your Coupler.io workspace — views on Google Search and Maps by phone and desktop, the calls, website clicks, direction requests and bookings those views turned into, actions per 100 views, and how each location moved against the period before and the same period last year. Use for "how is my Google Business Profile doing", "are we getting more calls from Google Maps", "how many people found us on Google this month", "which of our locations is underperforming on Google", "did our local listing views drop", "GBP performance report", "Google My Business insights" — even when the user never says "performance". This is the operator's read of the listing itself. For what people typed to find it use google-business-profile-search-keywords; for ratings and replies use google-business-profile-reviews-and-replies; for the write-up a client reads use google-business-profile-client-report. Google Business Profile only.
